title: Find customers who referred nobody
prompt: A customer's referred_by holds the id of the customer who referred them, or NULL. Return the first_name of every customer who has referred nobody: no other customer has their id in referred_by. Sort by first_name.
hints: This is about rows that do not exist. Which test is safe when the column holds NULLs?
For each customer, ask whether any customer row has referred_by equal to their id.
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers AS r WHERE r.referred_by = c.id)

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses NOT IN over a column that contains NULL, which is never true.
Answers a different question: who was not referred by anybody.

feedback: If your query returns no rows, look for a NULL in the list after NOT IN. Then check that you are asking about the customer's own id.
